== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1230_116</code>, Virtual Block 3 slip 115), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-115-Mon_Calamari_Star_Cruiser.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-L-moncalamaristarcruiser-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “For each Imperial starship on table, deploys -1 (to a minimum of 3). May add 5 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 3 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1230_116</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 3 set mark, slip number 115 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB3-115-Mon_Calamari_Star_Cruiser-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B07 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
